title: feat: support ON DELETE SET NULL for foreign keys
body:
Add `ast.OnDeleteSetNull` and parse the action in `CREATE TABLE` and
`ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY`. Keep interleaving actions unchanged.

Add golden coverage for named/multi-column constraints, malformed `SET NULL`,
and rejection in interleaving clauses.


- closes #480 480

title: Update dependency hugo to v0.169.0
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| [hugo](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo) | uses-with | minor | `0.168.0` → `0.169.0` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>gohugoio/hugo (hugo)</summary>

### [`v0.169.0`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/tag/v0.169.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/compare/v0.168.0...v0.169.0)

The main motivation behind this release is to get out a build with [Go 1.27.3](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.3+label%3ACherryPickApproved), which blocks trust in a small set of intermediate certificates due to specific security concerns around their operation. See the [eMudhra incident](https://go.dev/blog/emudhra-incident) for more information. This affects Hugo features that fetch remote resources over HTTPS, e.g. `resources.GetRemote`.

This release also contains some security hardening of the template functions and menu entries that can render content as HTML (see below), a deprecation of looking up reserved front matter fields via `.Params` (also below), a faster and more robust `plainify`, and a set of bug fixes.

##### Security notes

Templates are trusted in Hugo, but content (including front matter) is not necessarily. This release tightens a few places where values from content could end up rendered as unescaped HTML:

- `pre` and `post` values in menu entries defined in **front matter** are now HTML escaped, unless `text/html` is allowed in [`security.allowContent`](https://gohugo.io/configuration/security/), which already marks HTML in `/content` as trusted. A warning (`warning-menu-pre-post-html-escaped`) is logged when a value containing HTML markup is escaped. Menu entries defined in the project configuration are not affected. [`f63482b`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/f63482bf)
- `emojify` and `plainify` now return a `string` unless the input is `template.HTML`, in which case the result is also `template.HTML`. Previously both always returned `template.HTML`, so e.g. `{{ .Title | emojify }}` would mark a potentially unsafe title as safe HTML. If you relied on the old behavior with trusted input, pipe the result through `safeHTML`. Thanks to [@​Reload3d](https://redirect.github.com/Reload3d) for reporting this. [#​15452](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15452)

##### Deprecations

Reserved front matter fields such as `title`, `date` and `summary` are currently also stored in `.Params`. Lookups such as `.Params.title` (and `ByParam "title"`, `where .Pages "Params.title" ...` etc.) are now redirected to the corresponding `Page` method and logged as deprecated, unless the field was set in the `params` section of front matter. The content of `.Params` is unchanged for now. [`53e1fef`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/53e1fef9)

| Deprecated               | Use instead         |
| ------------------------ | ------------------- |
| `.Params.date`           | `.Date`             |
| `.Params.description`    | `.Description`      |
| `.Params.draft`          | `.Draft`            |
| `.Params.expirydate`     | `.ExpiryDate`       |
| `.Params.keywords`       | `.Keywords`         |
| `.Params.lastmod`        | `.Lastmod`          |
| `.Params.layout`         | `.Layout`           |
| `.Params.linktitle`      | `.LinkTitle`        |
| `.Params.publishdate`    | `.PublishDate`      |
| `.Params.slug`           | `.Slug`             |
| `.Params.summary`        | `.RawSummary` (new) |
| `.Params.title`          | `.Title`            |
| `.Params.translationkey` | `.TranslationKey`   |
| `.Params.type`           | `.Type`             |
| `.Params.weight`         | `.Weight`           |

##### Bug fixes

- hugolib: Fix template change detection when saving via temp file and rename [`46e51f3`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/46e51f30) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15484](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15484)
- markup/goldmark: Fix auto heading ID when link text starts with a bracket [`c22158c`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/c22158c1) [@​chanellebingham](https://redirect.github.com/chanellebingham) [#​15472](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15472)
- urls: Fix JoinPath panic with empty slice [`ce5d232`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/ce5d232b) [@​Ferdinand-MZ](https://redirect.github.com/Ferdinand-MZ) [#​15473](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15473)
- js: Fix js.Build with browser-disabled extensionless requires [`2efee51`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/2efee511) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15481](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15481)
- Fix Site.Key used in e.g. partialCached [`b86e0ca`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/b86e0caa) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15466](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15466)
- ci: Fix Windows running out of disk space and simplify test runs [`77230eb`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/77230eba) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep)
- hugolib: Fix build hang after too many page render errors [`85fb23f`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/85fb23f1) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15449](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15449)
- tpl/cast: Fix nil pointer panic in hugo gen docshelper [`8df3180`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/8df31809) [@​jmooring](https://redirect.github.com/jmooring) [#​15444](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15444)

##### Improvements

- Redirect .Params.title etc. to .Title etc. and deprecate it [`53e1fef`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/53e1fef9) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep)
- ci: Revert to plain go install honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck\@​latest [`3e67572`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/3e67572c) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep)
- navigation: Escape pre/post in front matter menu entries [`f63482b`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/f63482bf) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep)
- Upgrade to Go 1.27.3 [`7343fc9`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/7343fc9c) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep)
- resources: Make processed image key stable across builds [`ff4eab7`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/ff4eab75) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15467](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15467)
- tpl: Make StripHTML (plainify) more robust and faster [`7ec3a36`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/7ec3a366) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15462](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15462)
- tpl/transform: Make emojify and plainify preserve template.HTML input type [`895f583`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/895f5837) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15452](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15452)
- Make emojify return a string [`87bf585`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/87bf5858) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15452](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15452)
- Skip staticcheck in check.sh unless --full is set [`9d50291`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/9d502917) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep) [#​15453](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/issues/15453)
- Delete CLAUDE.md [`683a877`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/683a877f) [@​bep](https://redirect.github.com/bep)

##### Dependency Updates

- build(deps): bump github.com/getkin/kin-openapi from 0.151.0 to 0.152.0 [`6e494d0`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/6e494d01) [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot]
- build(deps): bump github.com/tdewolff/minify/v2 from 2.24.19 to 2.24.22 [`8c1fdca`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/8c1fdcac) [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot]
- build(deps): bump github.com/tdewolff/parse/v2 from 2.8.16 to 2.8.18 [`ed22b85`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/ed22b85c) [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot]
- build(deps): bump github.com/getkin/kin-openapi from 0.149.0 to 0.151.0 [`4102d1a`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/4102d1af) [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot]
- build(deps): bump golang.org/x/tools from 0.51.0 to 0.52.0 [`ac5af66`](https://redirect.github.com/gohugoio/hugo/commit/ac5af664) [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot]

</details>

title: Implement Spanner Graph queries
body:
This PR implements #98 except DDLs.
I want to separate `{CREATE | DROP} PROPERTY GRAPH` DDL to another PR.

* [x] `GRAPH_TABLE` operator
* [x] Graph subqueries as GoogleSQL expression
* [x] Graph functions/predicates as GoogleSQL expression
* [x] [GQL statements](https://cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements?hl=en#language_list)
  * [x] FILTER statement
  * [x] FOR statement
  * [x] LET statement
  * [x] LIMIT statement
  * [x]  MATCH statement
  * [x] NEXT statement
  * [x] OFFSET statement
  * [x] ORDER BY statement
    * [x] collation
  * [x] RETURN statement
  * [x] SKIP statement
  * [x] WITH statement
  * [x] Set operation
  * [x] Graph hints
* [x] Path Patterns
* [x] Misc
  * [x] Add tests
  * [x] Support in ./tools/parse
  * [x] Implement all `Pos()` and `End()`
  * [x] Clean up
  * [x] Add helper functions (requires Go 1.20 because `sqlOpt` requires [`comparable` with interface](https://tip.golang.org/doc/go1.20#language))
    * [x] Bump Go version to 1.20
  * [x]  Add godoc
